# @cormijs/cache

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cormijs/cache/next?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cormijs/cache)

The cache of a Cormi app (ctx.cache): key-value tables with expiry, in memory; Redis and the database with @cormijs/cache-redis and @cormijs/cache-database

```yaml
- name: '@cormijs/cache'
```

这是 [Cormi](https://github.com/cormijs/cormi) 的一部分：以 Cordis 为插件宿主的全栈框架。文档见 [缓存](https://cormi.js.org/guide/cache)。
